newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse chalks up more gains on strong volume.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse chalks up more gains on strong volume.

text.p: Greek shares had another winning session, closing with gains of 2.14 percent on Tuesday with market watchers saying the market had more upside potential and could reach the 1,200 level soon.

"The market has momentum. Even if it corrects on Wednesday, we'll still be looking at a bullish market. Foreign investors' interest in the Greek bourse is constantly growing," said John Glykos assistant fund manager at Doriki Mutual Funds.
"There is euphoria in the market and people find stocks the best investment alternative nowadays," he added.
He forecast that inflation will ease to 7.2 percent in March and drop to 6.6 percent in May, figures which would encourage further investment interest in stocks.
The general share index closed up 2.14 percent or 24.07 points at 1149.20 from Monday's 1125.13. It opened at 1135.45. Trading volume rose to 18.4 billion drachmas on volume of 6.0 million shares.
Gainers led losers 129 to 88 with 28 issues unchanged on 245 traded.
Banks gained 2.97 percent, construction rose 3.33 percent while small caps lost 0.03 percent and investment shares rose 0.27 percent. Industrials closed 1.38 percent higher.
